bio:
Of Fockenberg-Limbach (Kusel), daughter of Conrad Birgert; married Caspar Grub 1642. Her father Conrad Birgert is John's 10th-great-grandfather (speculative).

FamilySearch (as 'Elisabetha Birkhert') gives her birth in 1618 at Fockenberg-Limbach and her death at Berschweiler on 13 Sep 1685, and names her parents as Conradt Birgert and Anna Eva Jacob ([R4-S1]). Her marriage to Caspar Grub on 9 Jan 1642 is indexed in 'Germany Marriages' with Conradt Birkhert as her father. Her attached records include her appearance as the mother 'Elisabetha Grub' in the baptism of a son Johann ([R4-S1]). None of these was read in Round 4.
